summary: Gate root-first replication summaries on authenticated peer capabilities for mixed-version compatibility

replay.detail: Existing replicated records retain their interpretation and replay order.

schema.detail: No durable schema or replicated record format changes.

rules.detail: Replication authority, authentication, membership admission and record convergence rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Unknown and legacy peers receive explicitly complete-bucket summaries, including empty stores. Root-only summaries require a fresh challenge-bound authenticated ROOT_FIRST response; replayable inbound requests cannot enable capabilities. Capability knowledge persists per peer and refreshes when identity or build changes, rather than expiring on a timer. An authenticated metadata incompatibility clears negotiated support so the next ordinary round sends complete proofs after a peer rollback, without a full-inventory fallback or extra retry.

downtime.detail: No fleet-wide simultaneous upgrade or data migration is required.

manual.detail: No new configuration is required. Existing opt-in telemetry exports st.replication.exchanges with bounded capability labels unknown, legacy and root_first and outcome labels success and failure.

recovery.detail: A previous binary can resume from the same durable records; mixed-version exchanges retain complete-bucket summaries until root-first support is authenticated.
